candidate_requirements.requirement: Request smoking/vaping and other relevant inhalational, occupational or medication exposures with timing.
candidate_requirements.rationale: Progressive unexplained respiratory symptoms and a task focused on exposure require an actual exposure history; no particular final diagnosis is needed.
candidate_requirements.acceptable_alternatives: General smoking/vaping, environmental/occupational and medication pulmonary-risk questions. Exact device, chemical or dose details absent from the source are not required.
candidate_requirements.deadline: Before the final assessment, within the six question turns. Emergency escalation must not be delayed to exhaust the question budget.

candidate_requirements.requirement: Clarify the clinical course and prior treatment response.
candidate_requirements.rationale: A month of progression despite presumed COPD treatment challenges simple continuation of the initial label.
candidate_requirements.acceptable_alternatives: Symptoms, duration and previous steroid/antibiotic courses with response; equivalent review of outpatient records counts.
candidate_requirements.deadline: Before the final assessment, within the six question turns. Emergency escalation must not be delayed to exhaust the question budget.

candidate_requirements.requirement: Seek current oxygenation/severity and chest or infection investigations.
candidate_requirements.rationale: Supplemental oxygen at admission makes respiratory status and the pattern of lung disease immediately consequential.
candidate_requirements.acceptable_alternatives: Current observations/oxygen requirement plus chest imaging and focused infection evidence, or an equivalent urgent respiratory assessment. An unavailable requested saturation or blood gas remains a valid request; exhaustive serology is not essential.
candidate_requirements.deadline: Before the final assessment, within the six question turns. Emergency escalation must not be delayed to exhaust the question budget.
